stepper.title: Setup guide
stepper.description: Follow these steps to set up Frak in your store. Steps 2 to 4 take one click each.

step1.title: Connect your store to Frak
step1.description: This creates your Frak account for this store. It takes a few seconds. Step 2 opens when it is done.
step1.error: We could not connect your store. Try again. If it keeps failing, email hello@frak-labs.com.

step2.title: Turn on order tracking
step2.description: Frak needs to see the orders placed in your store to pay rewards. This adds a pixel (a small piece of tracking code) to your store. Step 3 opens when it is done.

step3.title: Connect order tracking to Shopify
step3.description: Shopify will send each order update to Frak, so rewards are paid on real orders. In Shopify this is called a webhook. Step 4 opens when it is done.

step4.title: Connect order tracking to Frak
step4.description: This lets Frak accept the order updates sent by Shopify. The next step opens when it is done.

step5.title: Turn on Frak in your theme
step5.description: In the theme editor, switch on Frak Listener, then click Save at the top right. Frak Listener lets your store show rewards and the sharing window. Come back here: this step ticks by itself.
step5.imageAlt: The Frak Listener switch in the theme editor

step6.title: Add the share button in your theme
step6.descriptionShare: In the theme editor, add the Frak Sharing Button to your product page as shown below, then click Save at the top right.
step6.imageAlt: The Frak Sharing Button in the theme editor
step6.noProduct: Add a product to your store first. Then come back to add the share button.

step7.title: Add the banner in your theme
step7.description: In the theme editor, add the Frak Banner to a page (for example the Home page), then click Save at the top right. It tells customers who arrive from a referral link what they earn.

optionalSetup.title: Finish your setup
optionalSetup.description: Your store is live and can already pay rewards. These optional steps help more customers share your store. Add them when you are ready.

shareButton.title: Add the share button to your product pages
shareButton.description: Adds a share button to each product page. When a visitor shares and a friend buys, the visitor earns a reward.

banner.title: Add the referral banner to your theme
banner.description: Shown only to people who arrive from a referral link. It tells them they were invited and what they earn if they buy.
